stories.title: ‘Have no illusions’: Kundi tells Afghan Taliban Pakistan will not tolerate attacks after Angoor Adda firing
stories.brief: The incident took place on Tuesday night when Afghan security forces opened unprovoked fire on Pakistan Army border posts and residential areas in the Angoor Adda border area.

stories.title: K-P governor warns Afghan Taliban against further aggression towards Pakistan
stories.brief: The remarks came after the Afghan Taliban regime targeted civilian areas in South Waziristan's Angoor Adda along the border, injuring five members of a family and killing one member on Tuesday night.

stories.title: Nine terrorists killed in two intelligence-based operations in Balochistan: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces killed nine terrorists belonging to Indian backed Fitna al-Hindustan during two Intelligence-Based Operations (IBOs) in Balochistan's Kachhi and Wadh districts, the military's media wing said on Wednesday.

stories.title: Pakistan urges US, Iran to honour Islamabad MoU during UNSC debate on Iran's nuclear programme
stories.brief: Pakistan on Tuesday urged Iran and the United States to honour their commitments under the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) and return to negotiations as the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) debated Iran’s nuclear program. Pakistan is a ​key mediator between the US and ⁠Iran.

stories.title: US costs of Iran war rise to over $47 billion, according to Pentagon estimate
stories.brief: The US military has spent over $47 billion so far to prosecute the war in Iran, more than 25% higher than the Defence Department's estimate in July, according to Pentagon data obtained by Reuters.

stories.title: Snowfall lures tourists to Galiyat resorts
stories.brief: Nathiagali witnessed a substantial influx of domestic tourists following forecasts of snowfall by the Meteorological Department. At nearby Ayubia, families queued for the famous chairlift, enjoying panoramic views of the snow-covered mountains.

stories.title: Afghan posts destroyed after border shelling
stories.brief: The Pakistan Army on Tuesday night destroyed Afghan Taliban check posts after they targeted civilian areas in South Waziristan's Angoor Adda along the border, injuring five members of a family and killing one member.

stories.title: Piracy to draw 10 years in jail, Rs25m fine

stories.title: SC seeks clarity on DNA evidence in rape conviction
stories.brief: The Supreme Court has sought further assistance from lawyers on three key legal questions in a unique rape case involving a 25-year-old woman with hearing and speech impairments, including whether an accused can be convicted solely on the basis of DNA evidence.
